plan.question: Are the remaining free-action errors caused by missing multi-step temporal information, or by ranking / utility / option-preservation / retreat-specific logic / label structure?

stage3f.rule: Stage 3G reads these; it never rewrites a Stage 3F artifact, certificate, hash, fact, the Decision Evaluation Contract, authority or the expert roster. A Stage 3G result that bears on a frozen fact is reported as new Stage 3G evidence, never as an edit of the fact.

hypotheses.H1_MULTI_STEP_TEMPORAL: residual error is materially reduced by legitimate multi-step future-state information
hypotheses.H2_RANKING_OR_UTILITY: the representation carries sufficient information but the linear diagnostic ranking is too weak
hypotheses.H3_OPTION_PRESERVATION: the missing signal is preservation of future choices / maneuverability / survivability, not raw future-state prediction
hypotheses.H4_RETREAT_SPECIFIC: the persistent retreat residual is a specific action-semantics or decision-rule exception
hypotheses.H5_MULTIPLE_OPTIMAL_LABEL_STRUCTURE: a material portion of apparent error comes from exact top-1 evaluation in states with several equally optimal actions
hypotheses.H6_MIXED: more than one mechanism is independently material
hypotheses.negativeResult: a negative temporal result is a valid PASS

horizons.labelDepth: the oracle scores a candidate by its immediate FORGE_REWARD_V2 scalar plus GREEDY_CONTINUATION_V1 for the row's label horizon h in {1,3,5,8} continuation steps
horizons.truncatedReturn: T_k = immediate + the first k-1 continuation rewards of the same oracle branch (vector-accumulated, then scalarised, exactly as the oracle); T_1 is the one-step successor; T_{h+1} equals the label total
horizons.labelLeakGuard: for a row with label horizon h, T_k with k >= h+1 IS the label; the primary temporal test therefore uses only PARTIAL_k rows (h+1 > k), where the future supplied is strictly shorter than the label depth. Full-population values are reported only as PRIVILEGED_UPPER_BOUND with the label-complete share disclosed.
horizons.consequenceDepth: d = the smallest number of continuation steps (0..4) whose truncated return T_{d+1} ranks only optimal zero-cost candidates at the top; none within 4 -> 5

strata.H0: d = 0: the immediate outcome already identifies an optimal action

horizons.status: diagnostic only; the strategic H0-H4 benchmark of the future roadmap is not frozen here

blocks.NEW: Stage 3G.2 observable representation, G_PATH_MAIN (TYPE, CANDIDATE, GEOMETRY, GP main; TYPE x 30 state features)
blocks.PAIRS: all pairwise products of the 20 candidate-level NEW columns (TYPE, CANDIDATE, GEOMETRY, GP)
blocks.ONESTEP: T_1 - max, T_1 - mean over the state's candidates (PRIVILEGED)
blocks.OPTION: option preservation along the oracle branch (PRIVILEGED): legalT1, legalT2, safeT1, safeT2, retreatT1, retreatT2, irreversibleEntry, hazardLockIn
blocks.TEMPORAL: decision-relevant temporal quantities over four continuation steps (PRIVILEGED): failureWithin4, hazardSteps4, irreversibleLoss4, dObjectiveT2, dObjectiveT4, dResourceT2, dResourceT4, optionTypesT2
blocks.PRIV: Stage 3F.6-P.1A-SYM privileged kernel relations (PRIVILEGED; action-semantics probe for the retreat classification)

NEW_LINEAR.role: LINEAR_BASELINE (must reproduce the Stage 3G.1/3G.2 model hash)

scorers.BEST_CAPACITY: whichever of NEW_INTERACTION / NEW_NONLINEAR has the higher CAL top-1 (ties within 1e-9 -> NEW_INTERACTION); the capacity-controlled comparator
scorers.deployable: all three read only the Stage 3G.2 observable representation; they remain diagnostics and are never promoted

plan.eligibility: unchanged Stage 3F.6-P.1A-SYM / Stage 3G: a zero-cost action is legal and optimal; candidates are the legal zero-cost actions of the symmetric surface

partitions.CAL: P.1D CAL: MLP width and BEST_CAPACITY selection only
partitions.STAGE3G3_HOLDOUT: PRIMARY sealed, seed 5021, levels 0-5 canonical order

metrics.OPTIMAL_SET_HIT: expected probability the chosen zero-cost candidate is in the oracle optimal set (uniform over tied top scores) - the Stage 3G FREE_ACTION_TOP1
metrics.TOP1_EXACT: expected probability the chosen candidate is the oracle representative (the optimal zero-cost candidate with the smallest canonical-frame identity)
metrics.NORMALIZED_REGRET: regret / max regret of the state
metrics.MULTI_OPTIMAL_RATE: share of rows with two or more optimal zero-cost candidates
metrics.NEAR_TIE_SHARE: share of residual weight whose normalised regret <= NEAR_TIE_NREG

materiality.rule: difference >= MATERIAL_TOP1_GAIN, bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0, and normalised regret not worse: the frozen Stage 3F.6-P.1A-SYM / Stage 3G materialGain rule
materiality.bothPartitions: every hypothesis needs materiality on STAGE3G3_HOLDOUT AND STAGE3G3_OOD; a HOLDOUT-only effect never justifies transition prediction
materiality.integrity: NEW feature and prediction D4 equivariance = 1, identity-renaming invariance = 1, candidate-order invariance = 1 for every scorer and diagnostic, temporal-feature D4 equivariance = 1, rollout fidelity = 1, one-step fidelity = 1, privileged-key scan clean, poisoning probe = 1

decisionRules.H1_MULTI_STEP_TEMPORAL_MATERIAL: exists k in {2,3,4}: on PARTIAL_k rows of HOLDOUT and of OOD, D_Hk - NEW_LINEAR is MATERIAL and D_Hk - BEST_CAPACITY is MATERIAL, and D_Hk - NEW_LINEAR has CI lower bound > 0 on the UNIQUE_OPTIMAL PARTIAL_k rows (multiple-optimal control)
decisionRules.MULTI_STEP_TEMPORAL_VALUE_OOD_STABLE: some k material on HOLDOUT (the H1 criteria) is also material on OOD
decisionRules.H2_RANKING_CAPACITY_MATERIAL: BEST_CAPACITY - NEW_LINEAR MATERIAL on HOLDOUT and OOD
decisionRules.H3_OPTION_PRESERVATION_MATERIAL: D_OPTION - NEW_LINEAR MATERIAL on HOLDOUT and OOD
decisionRules.H4_RETREAT_SPECIFIC_SUPPORTED: the retreat classification includes ACTION_SEMANTICS_LIMITED or RANKING_LIMITED
decisionRules.RETREAT_CLASSIFICATION: on RETREAT_OPTIMAL rows (both partitions): RANKING_LIMITED if BEST_CAPACITY - NEW_LINEAR MATERIAL; TEMPORAL_LIMITED if some D_Hk - NEW_LINEAR MATERIAL on its PARTIAL_k rows; OPTION_PRESERVATION_LIMITED if D_OPTION - NEW_LINEAR MATERIAL; ACTION_SEMANTICS_LIMITED if D_PRIVILEGED_RELATIONS - NEW_LINEAR MATERIAL; LABEL_STRUCTURE_LIMITED if >= LABEL_STRUCTURE_SHARE of NEW_LINEAR residual weight is near-tie (normalised regret <= NEAR_TIE_NREG); one class -> that class, several -> MIXED, none -> UNRESOLVED
decisionRules.H5_MULTIPLE_OPTIMAL_MATERIAL: OPTIMAL_SET_HIT - TOP1_EXACT of NEW_LINEAR >= MATERIAL_TOP1_GAIN on HOLDOUT and OOD (exact-action evaluation would count harmless tie choices as failures). Reported alongside: Stage 3G.1/3G.2 measured optimal-set hit, so its residual is not inflated by label ties
decisionRules.H6_MIXED: two or more of H1-H5 supported
decisionRules.TRANSITION_PREDICTION_NOW_JUSTIFIED: H1_MULTI_STEP_TEMPORAL_MATERIAL (which already requires HOLDOUT and OOD, the ranking-capacity control and the multiple-optimal control)
decisionRules.WORLD_MODEL_WORK_NOW_JUSTIFIED: TRANSITION_PREDICTION_NOW_JUSTIFIED and, for a material k, D_Hk - D_OPTION and D_Hk - D_TEMPORAL_FEATURES are both MATERIAL on PARTIAL_k rows of HOLDOUT and OOD (the value is not captured by deterministic horizon features or option-preservation state)
decisionRules.RESIDUAL_ATTRIBUTION: for each model X: RESOLVED = sum over rows of max(0, hit_X - hit_NEW) / NEW residual weight, BROKEN = sum max(0, hit_NEW - hit_X) / the same, NET = RESOLVED - BROKEN. Replaces the Stage 3G.1/3G.2 single-column separation taxonomy, which was permissive (it counted any differing column as "represented")

decisionEvaluation.contract: SENTINEL_DECISION_EVALUATION_CONTRACT_V1 (frozen by Stage 3F; unchanged); no world model is ranked
decisionEvaluation.CAD_DIAGNOSTIC: share of NEW_LINEAR residual weight where T_k strictly ranks every optimal candidate above every wrongly chosen one (k = 1..5), on all rows and on PARTIAL_k rows
decisionEvaluation.CR_DIAGNOSTIC: NEW_LINEAR regret - D_Hk regret on PARTIAL_k rows (absolute and relative)
decisionEvaluation.DDV_DIAGNOSTIC: D_Hk - NEW_LINEAR top-1 on PARTIAL_k rows and on all rows, labelled PRIVILEGED_UPPER_BOUND; never deployable DDV
decisionEvaluation.FPE: not measured: no predictor is evaluated; the lifecycle provides RESOLVED_CONFIRMED / RESOLVED_REFUTED for future FPE accounting
decisionEvaluation.TCA: not measured: no trust gate exists yet; lifecycle status and confidence are the future inputs

plan.exclusion: reject any record, world or topology hash claimed by the 80,000-row Stage 3F lineage, the 12,000 Stage 3G.1/3G.2 sealed rows, or earlier Stage 3G.3 admissions
plan.admission: P.1D benchmark-bound corpusRecord, canonical seed > level > horizon > objectives > roles > shape order; every 25th candidate carries D4 evidence

notPermitted: exposing simulator futures to a runtime-facing contract
plan.amendmentProcess: a harness-only defect found after the sealed run is fixed by a disclosed amendment binding the before/after bytes of the changed file and requiring the scientific sections to equal the preserved first run exactly
